title: Energy Expelled Rate
description: Essential Criteria: The correct calculation of the energy expelled to the room must be provided.

title: Power Supplied
description: Essential Criteria: The correct rate of electrical energy supplied must be calculated.

title: Coefficient of Performance
description: Essential Criteria: The coefficient of performance must be accurately determined.

title: Heat Extraction Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the heat extracted from the water must be shown correctly.

title: Temperature Conversion
description: Important Criteria: The temperatures must be converted to Kelvin correctly for calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Final Answer Format
description: Optional Criteria: Final answers should be presented clearly and in the correct format.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign errors in calculations must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors in the calculations, such as conversion factors, should be checked.
